easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Vizier of Many Faces.
description:
Cast Vizier of Many Faces by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Vizier of Many Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Vizier of Many Faces. Choose to have Vizier of Many Faces enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.
